Adjacent (NOT counted as a leak of this unit, but noted): `atkOfMaxHpPct` ("— Cinderella, Maiden:IR"), `buff.removeOnReload` ("cinderella's S1 Charge Speed toggle") and `flatDamage.rampSec` ("cinderella's stacks") all name the BASE unit `cinderella`, a different unit from `cinderella-crystal-wave`. I wrote the Pierce assertion from the KIT TEXT alone (Pierce is granted inside the Snipe Mode block ⇒ an unconditional whole-fight `hasPierce:true` is the nearest-wrong), and kept every Snipe-Mode-shape assertion presence-conditional so the leaked encoding could not steer a GREEN/RED outcome.

fixtures: controlComp('cinderella-crystal-wave', true) for ALL 11 runs — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / cinderella-crystal-wave (B3, focus) / helm (B3), Fire boss, 180s, deterministic (no seed). helm is kept ON deliberately rather than switched off: she is a SECOND Burst III, so a subset of Full Bursts is completed by her burst and not CCW's, which is the only in-fixture way to discriminate the skill2 rider's 'entering Full Burst AFTER THIS UNIT uses her Burst Skill' (ownBurstGate:'cast') from a plain fullBurstEnter keying. B1+B2 are mandatory — a lone B3 makes ZERO Full Bursts and every FB-keyed assertion would be vacuous. Runs (11 total): base; attackDamagePct 24→0; atkPct 29→0; coreDamagePct 26→0; partsDamagePct 26.21→0; drop flatDamage 900; drop flatDamage 6000; drop fillGauge; hyper-gauge (threshold 20 / 40%); drop the 1189.66/833.79 riders; delete ownBurstGate from the rider blocks. Because damage events are not documented to carry a unit slug, every damage-line claim is a COUNT DELTA against its own counterfactual, and each such test also asserts teammate totals are byte-identical — which validates the 'a pure damage removal perturbs nobody else' premise in-line instead of assuming it.
gaps: skill1 Snipe Mode toggle trigger + duration (it.skip) — activation is 'reloading to max ammunition WHILE IN the Preparation for Change state' and the removal condition is the SAME event (a condition-toggle). No TriggerDef expresses reload-to-max, and weaponSwap.durationSec demands a wall-clock bound the kit never states. Snipe duty cycle is a ⚑ per-unit estimate; RECIPE: count Snipe-Mode seconds per 180s off a focus recording.

skill1 'Additional Effect 2: Full Charge expends 40 round(s)' (it.skip) — ⚑ kit-internal CONTRADICTION: Snipe Mode caps Max Ammunition at 15, so 40 ≥ 15 means every Full Charge empties the belt and forces a reload (consumeAmmo fraction 1). The competing reading — 40 spent against the base 300-round MG belt (fraction 0.1333) — is equally consistent with the text. Not resolvable blind.

skill1 'Preparation for Change: Reload time is fixed at 3 sec for 6 sec. Removed upon firing the last bullet.' (it.skip) — a stat CLAMP, not a reloadSpeedPct buff; no primitive (engine-modeling-gaps §1b). Whole-picture flag: base reloadFrames 171 = 2.85s, so 'fixed at 3 sec' is a slight SLOWDOWN, not a buff. The 'removed upon firing the last bullet' condition also has no representation.

skill2 Destroy ⇄ Pinpoint mutual removal (it.skip) — the state machine is driven entirely by Snipe Mode entry/exit; with the swap measurement-gated the fixture never enters Snipe, so the ACTIVE and INACTIVE cases cannot both be exercised and any assertion would be vacuous (non-vacuity requirement fails). Blind expectation: Pinpoint is live for the whole graded run.

skill2 FB-enter rider, 1189.66% Snipe-Mode branch (it.skip) — unreachable for the same reason; only the 833.79% core-strike branch is exercisable. Blind expectation: 833.79 carries core:true ('as core strike damage' — the only rider in this kit that earns the core bucket) and 1189.66 does not.

skill2 'Decoy: Creates an avatar with 70.34% of the skill user's final Max HP' (it.skip) — UNMODELED. Defensive/aggro primitive with no engine representation (v1 has no HP pool, the boss deals no damage), no damage channel and no tandem consumer anywhere in the kit.
